headline: BLUE STAR GOLD HITS VISIBLE GOLD IN ALL 5 MAIDEN HOLES AT AUMA — 10.60 g/t Au OVER 2m CONFIRMS 300m STRIKE IN NUNAVUT
snippet: Blue Star Gold Corp. (TSXV: BAU / OTCQB: BAUFF) reported initial results from Phase 2 of its 2026 exploration program at the Auma Project's Bamako Prospect in Nunavut, with all five completed holes (26ABD001–005) intersecting gold mineralization across an unconstrained 300-metre strike length at shallow depths. Top intercepts include 2.0 metres at 10.60 g/t Au (including 0.5 m at 39.1 g/t Au), 1.9 metres at 16.74 g/t Au, and a broad 8.0 metres at 2.65 g/t Au. Visible gold was observed in drill core, and the maiden 2,400-metre campaign demonstrates continuity between historical drilling and previously undrilled sections — setting up a maiden resource estimate.

headline: NEXGEN PCE URANIUM ZONE GROWS 17% TO 644m AS ROOK I MINE BUILDS — FIFTH RIG ADDED, BEST HOLES SINCE DISCOVERY
snippet: NexGen Energy Ltd. (TSX/NYSE: NXE) announced that drilling at the Patterson Corridor East (PCE) deposit has expanded the high-grade uranium subdomain's vertical extent by 17% to 644 metres, with hole RK-26-293 intersecting mineralization at 930 metres depth — among the best results since PCE's discovery. Holes RK-26-290c1 and RK-26-294 are the two strongest at PCE since the deposit was found. NexGen is adding a fifth drill rig at PCE to accelerate delineation simultaneously with the ongoing $2.2 billion Rook I mine construction, which broke ground August 14 — a rare dual-track strategy of exploring for a new deposit while building the current one.

headline: KORYX COPPER DRILLS 969m AT 0.27% CuEq IN NAMIBIA — LONGEST HAIB INTERCEPT EVER, HM177 HITS 1.06% Cu OVER 30m
snippet: Koryx Copper S.A. (TSXV: KRY) released assay results from 19 drill holes (8,586 metres) at the Haib Copper Project in southern Namibia, with hole HM167 returning 969 metres at 0.27% copper-equivalent from surface — the longest mineralised intersection in Haib's history. Hole HM177 added a near-surface 30-metre interval averaging 1.06% Cu with two 2-metre subintervals exceeding 4% Cu, some of the highest grades yet reported at the large-scale open-pit porphyry target. Haib is envisaged as a large-scale conventional sulphide milling and flotation operation, with the current drill program designed to support resource estimate upgrades.

headline: ZIJIN WARNS KAMOA-KAKULA FLOODING PUTS 57,000 TONNES COPPER AT RISK — SUPPLY SQUEEZE DEEPENS AT $6.75/lb
snippet: Zijin Mining Group disclosed in its half-year report that its attributable copper output from the Kamoa-Kakula complex in the DRC could fall by as much as 57,000 tonnes in 2026 as operations continue ramping up after seismic flooding disrupted the mine last year. Zijin holds a 44% stake; Ivanhoe Mines had already slashed project-level guidance in April from 380,000–420,000 tonnes to 290,000–330,000 tonnes. With LME copper at $6.75/lb and approaching record territory, the ongoing supply deficit at one of the world's largest copper operations adds fresh pressure to a market that CRU now describes as 'at best balanced' for 2026 despite an earlier 639,000-tonne surplus forecast.

headline: GOLD HOLDS $4,650 AHEAD OF TODAY'S PCE DATA AND WARSH JACKSON HOLE DEBUT — 64% ODDS FED HOLDS IN SEPTEMBER
snippet: Gold consolidated near $4,650 an ounce on Wednesday after a 7% gain over the prior five sessions, holding three-month highs as traders positioned ahead of today's core PCE price index print (consensus 0.2% month-on-month) and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's debut Jackson Hole address on Friday. Markets price a 64% probability of a September Fed hold, with a hotter PCE read seen as the primary short-term headwind. Silver softened to near $68 from a recent $70 two-month high, remaining underpinned by green-transition industrial demand. A softer PCE reading would clear the path for gold to challenge $4,700 again — a level it has tested twice in the past week.

headline: SPROTT DOUBLES SILVER STORM BET TO $15M, TAKES 100% OF OFFERING — LA PARRILLA SILVER MINE DRILLING TO ACCELERATE
snippet: Silver Storm Mining Ltd. (TSXV: SVRS) upsized its Eric Sprott-backed private placement from $7.5 million to $15.0 million, with Sprott's corporation subscribing for the entire 30 million units at $0.50 each and expected to close on or about August 25. Net proceeds will fund surface and underground drilling at the La Parrilla Silver Mine Complex in Durango, Mexico — a former First Majestic Silver producing operation. With silver near $68/oz and Sprott taking the full offering in a single subscription, the deal signals strong institutional conviction in a silver junior with an existing resource and established processing infrastructure.

headline: K2 GOLD FINDS 2,737 g/t Ag AND 4.37 g/t Au IN SURFACE GRABS AT MORNINGSTAR — NEW POLYMETALLIC TARGET 7km FROM MOJAVE DRILL
snippet: K2 Gold Corporation (TSXV: KTO) reported results from 613 rock chip and grab samples collected at the Morningstar Target in Inyo County, California — a newly identified polymetallic zone approximately 7 kilometres from K2's active Mojave gold drill program. Peak values include 2,737 g/t silver, 4.37 g/t gold, and 2.42% copper, with a second high-grade interval returning 1,420 g/t Ag, 7.44 g/t Au. The results indicate widespread skarn-style mineralization across discrete structural trends; K2 plans systematic channel sampling and drill target definition at Morningstar while Mojave drilling continues. Note: grab samples are selective and not representative of average grade.

headline: US AND JAPAN LOCK IN CRITICAL MINERALS ALLIANCE — FORGE FRAMEWORK COVERS 60 MINERALS, BYPASSES CHINESE SUPPLY CHAINS
snippet: The United States and Japan formalized a critical minerals partnership under the FORGE framework (Forum on Resource Geostrategic Engagement) at the August 2026 Critical Minerals Ministerial in Washington D.C., committing to joint sourcing and processing investment across 60 minerals designated critical by the Department of Defense — including rare earths, lithium, cobalt, and gallium. The deal is part of a rapidly expanding network of bilateral supply chain commitments signed this year with Australia, Canada, and the EU, designed to build self-reinforcing alternatives to Chinese-controlled mining, processing, and refining channels. Analysts see the FORGE architecture as the most durable institutional mechanism yet for pricing in Western supply chain resilience at project level.

headline: PAN AMERICAN SILVER, ALAMOS, IAMGOLD, ENDEAVOUR — FOUR GOLD-SILVER STOCKS ANALYSTS ARE WATCHING THIS AUGUST
snippet: With gold holding near $4,650 and silver approaching $70, Kalkine analysts flag four mid-tier producers as top names to watch in August 2026: Pan American Silver for its silver leverage and royalty optionality; Alamos Gold for its Island Gold Phase 3 expansion ramp-up and sector-leading reserve grade; IAMGOLD for its Côté Gold ramp in Ontario delivering higher ounces at improving AISC; and Endeavour Mining for West African production breadth and a reinstituted dividend. The analysis reflects a broader view that mid-tier operators — with operational leverage to gold and manageable balance sheets — offer better risk-adjusted returns than seniors at current metal prices.
